target_customer: Freelancers, companies and developers who send or receive payments in cryptocurrency
problem: Crypto payments lacked a standard way to issue payment requests and invoices with automated reconciliation. Request provided a protocol and apps for this.
business_model: Open protocol with REQ token, apps and fees; ecosystem and invoicing products
product_category: Crypto payment request protocol and invoicing

founders.name: Christophe Lassuyt
founders.background_notes: Later CEO of Request Finance per press.

competitors.name: Populous
competitors.what: Blockchain invoice finance platform with PPT token

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart contract based payment requests on Ethereum with a decentralised node network were new but built on standard contracts in 2017.

defensibility.rationale: Open source protocol with a token and a hoped for ecosystem. Copying the code was easy; the moat depended on adoption.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed the protocol. The Request ecosystem continued with spin out Request Finance.

market_need_then: The 2017 crypto boom created demand for crypto payments and tooling, shown by the roughly 33 million dollar token sale in October 2017.

branding.domain_note: Uses request.network; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Watermark R mark in green, with wordmark added in a later refresh
identity.visual_style: Green, curved structured patterns reflecting builder community per company blog

branding.brand_signature: Green color and watermark R which the community associates with the brand

rebrands.why: Company blog says green and the R watermark were kept and a wordmark added for recognition; exact date not confirmed, a New Year post and a 2023 review mention the refresh

branding.community_and_virality: Active r/RequestNetwork subreddit and community contributions to apps, per search results

brand_strength.rationale: Recognised in crypto circles through its token and community, but not a mainstream brand.

outcome_analysis: Request Network launched in the 2017 crypto cycle, raised about 33 million dollars in a token sale in October 2017, and still operates with a 12 person team as an open protocol with apps. A separate company, Request Finance, raised 5.5 million dollars in 2022 on top of the protocol. The timing tailwind funded it, but durable growth depended on later adoption.
notes: Token sale figures: Coin Bureau says 33.6 million, Changelly 32 million; 33 million used as rounded. Seedtable and AlphaGrowth list a 120k seed in March 2017, aggregator only so unverified. Coinranking naming YC as seed backer unverified. The 5.5 million seed of 2022 belongs to Request Finance, a separate entity, and is not recorded as a round. The competitor entry is dated 2018, a year after founding, because no source from 2017 was found. Website fetch returned empty content.
